title: 第52章 金乌神女画像第51章 圣灵自爆
lines: 火鸦羽族的大长老给白枫指的的路在那火鸦崖城的崖壁之后，火鸦羽族的大长老在后面小心翼翼的跟着白枫，最后二人来到了那崖壁的后面。
后面是一口火山，白枫还是第一次见到如此高的火山，本以为火鸦羽族背靠的崖壁红色的，光秃秃的是因为火鸦羽族开采过度，没想到这崖壁居然是一口火山的崖壁！
火山口很大，与普通火山不同的是，这火山直直往上，高耸入云，白枫不敢想象这火山要是喷发了，该喷射多高啊，影响多大啊！
火山口中岩浆翻滚，很多如同巢穴一般的方格布满内壁。
看到白枫有些疑惑，身后的火鸦羽族大长老赶忙解释：
“道友，这里是我火鸦羽族孵化的地方，幼年体全靠这火山孵化的，我火鸦羽族的收集的宝物，就在火山口下面。”
白枫回头瞥了这火鸦大长老一眼，火鸦大长老看到白枫那冰冷的眼神，心中一缩，赶忙继续解释：
“道友放心，我已经派人解除了那里的禁制，道友可以自行进入。”
白枫点了点头，随后飞身跳入火山口。
灼热的气浪扑面而来，熏的人睁不开眼睛，好在这气浪根本伤不了白枫丝毫，随着白枫跳入火山后，往下落去，发现火山中心一旁有一道石门。
现在的石门已经敞开，显然是被人打开了。
看着崖壁上密密麻麻挂着的虎牙羽族的卵，白枫没想到这羽族的孵化方式如此奇特，居然靠火山孵化。
好奇的看了一眼，白枫打量起眼前的石门。
石门毫不起眼，对着白枫敞开着，里面也已经燃起灯火，白枫走了进去。
进入以后发现，这里面看的空间十分庞大，整个空间依靠着无比庞大的火山中开凿出的一间庞大的密室。
看来火鸦羽族也是深思熟虑的把藏宝的地方放在这里的，这里不仅仅是火鸦羽族孵化，延续生命的地方，还是藏宝之地！这里的戒备肯定森严，一般人还真找不到，甚至进不来！
看着眼前琳琅满目的物品，白枫也是惊呆了，这火鸦羽族不愧是周边最强的，这里的珍宝无数，堆积如山，各种功法，丹药，护甲，还有满地的晶核，散发出来的各种气息胶着在一起，令人眼前一亮。
白枫也头一次看到如此多的宝物，不由分说的就开始收集起来，一股脑的都开始往自己的空间戒指里搬，戒指装不下以后，白枫索性直接装进那小世界残片中。
不一会，大半宝物就进了白枫的腰包，剩下的不过是一些低级物品，白枫看不上的。
火鸦羽族大长老并没有离开，而是远远的在门口等着，感受到藏宝地里面的气息衰弱，火鸦羽族大长老心在滴血。
那是火鸦羽族全族多少年的心血收集啊！现在就被这该死的人族给糟蹋了！
更为可气的这人族明明就一个神游巅峰境界，还就穿个大裤衩子，但是他们全族却奈何不了！
火鸦羽族大长老心有不甘，却只能在外面老老实实的等候。
白枫在里面全部收刮了一遍，只留下一些破烂，看着先前堆积如山的宝物被自己扫荡一空，白枫有些满意的点了点头。
不错，这次收获不少，经过古井通道，拿到自己的世界，又能滋养世界了！
就在白枫准备离开的时候，余光却注意到角落的一副画像。
这画像十分清晰，像是被启明城的高科技做的，栩栩如生，就像一个活人站在你的面前一样。
而白枫看到这张画像以后呆呆的愣在原地，随后飞身上前，一把扯下画像！
白枫直愣愣的看着画像中的人物沉默不语。
画中是一名女子，身着洁白的丝质长袍，缓缓立于虚空，如同仙子一般俯视下方众生，而这画像的角度就是从下往上做成的，女子神色肃穆，宝相庄严，一手拈花，一手扶丝，令人心生敬畏。
content_en:
The great elder of the Fire Crow Feather Tribe showed Bai Feng the path behind the cliff of Fire Crow Cliff City. The great elder of the Fire Crow Feather Tribe followed Bai Feng carefully, and finally the two of them came to the back of the cliff.
Behind is a volcano. This is the first time Bai Feng has seen such a high volcano. He thought that the cliff on the back of the Fire Crow Feather Tribe was red and bare because of over-exploitation by the Fire Crow Feather Tribe. Unexpectedly, this cliff turned out to be the cliff of a volcano!
The crater of the volcano is very large. Different from ordinary volcanoes, this volcano goes straight up and towers into the clouds. Bai Feng cannot imagine how high this volcano will erupt and how much impact it will have if it erupts!
The lava is rolling in the crater, and many nest-like squares cover the inner wall.
Seeing that Bai Feng was a little confused, the elder of the Fire Crow Feather Clan behind him quickly explained:
"Fellow Taoist, this is the place where my Fire Crow Feather Tribe was hatched. The young bodies are all hatched by this volcano. The treasures collected by my Fire Crow Feather Tribe are just under the crater."
Bai Feng turned back and glanced at the Fire Crow Great Elder. Seeing Bai Feng's cold eyes, the Fire Crow Great Elder shrank in his heart and hurriedly continued to explain:
"Don't worry, fellow Taoist, I have sent people to lift the restriction there. Fellow Taoist can enter on your own."
Bai Feng nodded, then flew into the crater.
The scorching wave of air hit his face, and Xun's person couldn't open his eyes. Fortunately, the wave of air couldn't hurt Bai Feng at all. As Bai Feng jumped into the volcano, he fell down and found a stone gate beside the center of the volcano.
The stone door is now open, and it has obviously been opened by someone.
Looking at the eggs of the Tiger Tooth Feather Clan hanging densely on the cliff, Bai Feng did not expect that the Yu Clan's incubation method was so strange, that they actually relied on volcanoes to incubate.
After taking a curious look, Bai Feng looked at the stone gate in front of him.
The stone door was inconspicuous and opened to Bai Feng. The lights were already lit inside, and Bai Feng walked in.
After entering, I found that the space seen inside was very huge, and the entire space relied on a huge secret room dug out of the extremely huge volcano.
It seems that the Fire Crow Feather Clan also carefully considered the place to hide their treasures here. This is not only a place where the Fire Crow Feather Clan hatches and continues their lives, it is also a place to hide treasures! The security here must be tight, and ordinary people really can't find it, or even get in!
Looking at the dazzling array of items in front of him, Bai Feng was also stunned. The Fire Crow Feather Tribe was indeed the strongest in the surrounding area. There were countless treasures here, piled up like mountains, various techniques, elixirs, armors, and crystal cores all over the ground. The various auras exuded were glued together, which made people's eyes light up.
It was the first time that Bai Feng saw so many treasures, and he couldn't help but start to collect them. They all began to move into his own space ring. When the ring couldn't fit in, Bai Feng simply put it directly into the fragment of the small world.
After a while, most of the treasures went into Bai Feng's pocket, and the rest were just some low-level items that Bai Feng didn't like.
The Great Elder of the Fire Crow Feather Tribe did not leave, but waited at the door from a distance. Feeling the weakening aura in the treasure place, the Great Elder of the Fire Crow Feather Tribe's heart was bleeding.
That is what the entire Firecrow Feather clan has been collecting for many years! Now they are being ruined by this damn human race!
What’s even more irritating is that this human race is clearly at the pinnacle of fugue and wears big pants, but the whole race can’t do anything about it!
The great elder of the Firecrow Feather Clan was unwilling, but he could only wait outside.
Bai Feng scraped everything inside, leaving only some tatters. Seeing that the previously piled treasures were swept away by himself, Bai Feng nodded with some satisfaction.
Yes, I gained a lot this time. After passing through the ancient well passage, I got my own world and can nourish the world again!
Just when Bai Feng was about to leave, he noticed a portrait in the corner from the corner of his eye.
This portrait is very clear, as if it was made by the high technology of Qiming City, and it is lifelike, just like a living person standing in front of you.
When Bai Feng saw this portrait, he froze on the spot, then flew forward and pulled off the portrait!
Bai Feng stared blankly at the characters in the portrait and remained silent.
In the painting, a woman is dressed in a pure white silk robe, standing slowly in the void, looking down at the beings below like a fairy. The angle of the portrait is made from bottom to top. The woman has a solemn expression and a majestic appearance. She is holding a flower in one hand and a silk in the other, which is awe-inspiring.
title_en: Chapter 52 Portrait of the Golden Crow Goddess Chapter 51 The Holy Spirit Explodes
